inc-bot: INCIDENT P1 - Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (hosted API). Detected 1200 5xx/min over last 2m. Paging oncall.
Alex K: I'm primary for this shift, taking it. Starting triage now. @Maria S are you ok to be secondary?
Maria S: yes I'm secondary. I'll monitor customer notifications and SLAs.
Samir P: quick question — initial traces show model-worker 500s and some LBs returning 502s. Which oncall owns the routing decisions here? runtime or infra?
Alex K: good Q. runtime owns model-workers and model variants; infra owns the LBs and routing. For cross-team triage: runtime handles worker errors/ooms, infra handles LB spikes and network issues. Support handles customer comms.
Lee T: digging into LB metrics now. I can see a spike of backends hitting connection resets to runtime-pool-rtx01. Could be worker OOMs causing sudden drops.
Alex K: Lee, can you post the last 50 lines of the runtime worker logs for rtx-01? Samir, can you check KV cache/missed prefix cache rates and model-worker memory usage?
Lee T: paste logs:
```
2026-02-18T12:45:02Z model-worker[rtx-01] ERROR oom after alloc 1.2G
2026-02-18T12:45:02Z model-worker[rtx-01] TRACE kvcache miss prefix_id=foo seq=324
2026-02-18T12:45:03Z proxy[rtx-01] 502 upstream reset
2026-02-18T12:45:05Z model-worker[rtx-01] restarting
```
Samir P: KV cache miss rate is up 6x, and p95 mem for model-worker processes is 98%. Looks like a model change caused memory regression on rtx-01. I can attempt an immediate rollback to the previous model variant.
Alex K: Let's follow the runtime runbook: rollback model variant on affected pool and scale out workers. Maria, please prepare customer-facing blurb. Lee, coordinate with infra to take rtx-01 out of rotation temporarily.
Maria S: drafting blurb: "We’re investigating elevated errors impacting text generation. Engineers are mitigating and routing traffic to a fallback model; ETA ~15-30m. We’ll update every 15 minutes." Will post in #status once we have confirmation.
Lee T: taking rtx-01 out of rotation now. Command:
```
infra-cli set-backend-state --pool runtime-pool-rtx01 --state DRAINING
```
Alex K: Samir, execute rollback and scale command. Use the runtime safe-run script.
Samir P: running:
```
./runtime-deploy rollback --model-id rtx-model-v2 --target-pool runtime-pool-rtx01
kubectl -n runtime-prod scale deployment/model-worker --replicas=10
```
Samir P: rollback initiated; scaling up replicas to 10. Monitoring.
Support Bot: Notifying customers with impacted keys u-123, u-456. Support runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/support/notify-customers
Maria S: posted customer blurb on status page and support channel. Will queue updates.
Alex K: quick on-call handoff note — I'm covering primary until 02:00 UTC. Maria will be secondary until 03:30 UTC then Nina is on deck for the 03:00-07:00 UTC window but Nina has PTO at 03:30-04:30. There's a potential coverage gap 03:30-04:30 UTC. We need someone to cover that slot or adjust rotation. @Nina Q can you confirm availability?
Nina Q: I can cover 03:30-04:30 if needed, but I'd prefer to swap 04:30-06:00 with Maria. If you want, I can update oncall-bot.
Alex K: OK please update oncall-rotation-bot and note who will be primary for the 03:30 handoff. Also add a short note in the incident doc indicating the temporary cover.
inc-bot: ACTION LOGGED: incident-2005000000 -> runbook: runtime/rollback, infra/drain-pool, support/notify. Pager history updated.
Samir P: rollback completed on rtx-01 pool, error rate dropping to baseline over last 90s. p95 latency stable. Continuing to monitor for 10m.
Lee T: infra is keeping rtx-01 drained. No abnormal network errors now.
Maria S: sending status update to customers: "Traffic routed to fallback model, error rates decreased. Engineers continue monitoring. Next update in 15m." Posted in #customer-status.
Alex K: If we see reoccurrence, escalate to infra/arch for kernel-level investigation. For now, keep watchers on p95 mem, kvcache miss rate, and 5xx rate.
Support Bot: Updated incident ticket INC-2005 with customer notices and engineers assigned (Alex K, Samir P, Lee T).
Alex K: OK team — I'll stay primary until resolution or 02:00 UTC. Maria, handoff to Nina at 03:30 per update. Anyone else please chime if you see anything odd.
Nina Q: confirmed, I'll take 03:30-06:00. Thanks.
inc-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - error rate returned to normal. Final status: rollback successful, drained affected pool, no customer escalations. Closing pager for oncall. Duration: ~18m.
